tierBenefits.2: One for grandma's house or the second bathroom — no more hauling the tub between floors.

benefits.title: Bathe standing up, no bending over
benefits.text: The heightened iron-frame stand lifts the basin to standing height, so you wash your baby without hunching over a tub on the floor.

benefits.title: Touch-sensor water temperature
benefits.text: The built-in touch sensor changes color to warn you if the water is too hot or too cold before baby gets in.

benefits.title: Folds flat in seconds
benefits.text: The frame folds down for storage between baths — no dedicated bathroom space needed.

benefits.title: Food-grade PP plastic
benefits.text: The basin is made from PP plastic, the same material used in baby bottles and feeding gear.

whyItWorks.heading: Why it works
whyItWorks.text: Most baby bathtubs sit on the floor or in the big tub, forcing parents to kneel or hunch over for the whole bath. Raising the basin to standing height on a stable iron frame removes that strain entirely, while the touch temperature sensor takes the guesswork out of water safety.
points: No kneeling or bending over the tub
Sensor flags unsafe water temperature before baby gets in
